_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
Find Theldurin the Lost.
Bring Yagyin's Digest to Theldurin.
Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.
Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Bring Kravel's Scheme to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Bring the Fool's Stout to the Gnome Pit Boss.
Bring the Fool's Stout to the Goblin Pit Boss.
Bring the Fool's Stout report to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village wants you to retrieve his grog, snuff and strongbox in Dustwallow Swamp.
Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village would like you to bring him 15 Searing Tongues and 15 Searing Hearts.
Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.
Speak with Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

Retrieve the Seaforium Booster for Razzeric in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring the Seaforium Booster to Shreev in Gadgetzan.
Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
Bring Deadmire's Tooth to Melor in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt.

Give Faustin's Truth Serum to Deathstalker Zraedus at Beggar's Haunt.
Take Zraedus's Brew to Infiltrator Marksen in Stonard.
Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.
Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.

quests.n: Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
quests.t: Speak to Menara's acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet and choose one of their paths to follow. Afterwards, bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Tabetha.
Bring 1 Jade and the Bolt Charged Bramble to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
Speak with Tabetha.
Bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

o.t: Kill the Demon of the Orb

quests.t: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
Retrieve an Obsidian Power Source and bring it to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Kill 12 Mana Surges in the allowed time limit.
Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what lore it has to offer, activate the Discs of Norgannon.
Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.
Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar. The necklace may be damaged.
Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.
Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Bring four Steel Breastplates and four Steel Plate Helms to Aturk the Anvil in Orgrimmar.
Speak with McGavan in Booty Bay.

Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

Bring two Heavy Mithril Breastplates and one Ornate Mithril Gloves to Trenton Lighthammer.

Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.
Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin. Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.
Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

Slay Vale Screechers and use Yeh'kinya's Bramble on their corpse.

Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.
If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.

quests.n: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
quests.t: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
